device.description: 10-bit 200 kSPS serial SAR ADC with 8 inputs, CFR, 8x FIFO, EOC/INT, internal reference and power-down
device.note: slas251a.pdf (SLAS251A) p.1 pinouts, p.3-4 terminal functions, p.5 serial interface and data formats (unipolar straight binary), p.6 power up and initialization, Table 1 command set, p.7 Table 2 CFR bit definitions, p.8 Table 3 sample and convert conditions, p.9-10 conversion modes (Table 4), p.11-13 read/write cycles, p.20-21 recommended operating conditions and timing (td(CSL-DOV), td(SCLK-DOV)), p.19 power down, p.24 operating characteristics (t(conv), self-test codes), p.34 date code information

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: p.7 Table 2 configuration register; no address (Write CFR Ah / Read CFR 9h). The power-on value is not documented (p.6: the device must be configured after power up); reset 0 here

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the channel of the last select command (Table 1 code bits 14-12)

commands.name: Select analog input channel (long sampling)
commands.note: p.6 Table 1: 0000b-0111b select analog input channel 0-7; CFR D9 = 1: 24-SCLK sampling, the conversion starts after the 28th SCLK (p.8 Table 3, p.9)

commands.name: Select analog input channel
commands.note: p.6 Table 1: 0000b-0111b select analog input channel 0-7; short sampling (12 SCLKs): the conversion starts after the 16th SCLK (p.8 Table 3, p.9). Wakes from power-down (p.19: an active CS restores the device)

commands.name: SW power down
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 8h; p.19: writing 8000h powers down analog and reference; CFR is retained

commands.name: Read CFR
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 9h; p.11: SDO outputs the CFR after the 4th SCLK (D11-D0 of the 16-bit frame; the first 4 bits are don't care). Works only in single shot mode (CFR D(6,5) = 00)

commands.name: Write CFR
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 Ah plus 12-bit data; p.13 write cycle (no conversion, no EOC/INT). A000h at power up determines the processor type (p.6)

commands.name: Select test, voltage = (REFP+REFM)/2 (long sampling)
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 Bh; p.24 self-test code 200h

commands.name: Select test, voltage = (REFP+REFM)/2
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 Bh; p.24 self-test code 200h

commands.name: Select test, voltage = REFM (long sampling)
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 Ch; p.24 self-test code 000h

commands.name: Select test, voltage = REFM
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 Ch; p.24 self-test code 000h

commands.name: Select test, voltage = REFP (long sampling)
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 Dh; p.24 self-test code 3FFh

commands.name: Select test, voltage = REFP
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 Dh; p.24 self-test code 3FFh

commands.name: FIFO read
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 Eh; p.12: the first FIFO content is output from the start of the cycle (the frame's normal output); the FIFO is not modeled

commands.name: Reserved
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 Fh plus data: reserved

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3-4 (terminal functions), p.5 (data formats), p.6 (Table 1 commands, initialization), p.7 (Table 2 CFR), p.8-10 (sampling, conversion modes), p.11-13 (read/write cycles), p.20-21 (ROC, timing), p.19 (power down), p.24 (t(conv), self-test)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal reference (CFR D11/D10) and the analog multiplexer; the result is the 0 V code 000h except the self-test codes
conversion output is the PREVIOUS result (OD9-OD0 in D15-D6, D5-D0 don't care, modeled as 0); SDO is 3-state after the 16th bit (idle z); the long-sampling 28-clock frame is shifted as 16 bits then z

conversion modes 01/10/11 (repeat, sweep, repeat sweep), the 8-level FIFO, sweep sequences (CFR D4-D3) and FIFO trigger levels (D1-D0): CFR stores them; every trigger runs a single conversion and FIFO read outputs the normal frame
conversion time: internal OSC 3.86 us max; SCLK-derived clocks (CFR D8-D7 = 01/10/11) are 14 x DIV / fSCLK, given at the 20 MHz maximum SCLK (700 / 2800 / 1400 ns)
the conversion starts after the 16th (short sampling) or 28th (long sampling, CFR D9) SCLK; the select command completes at that bit
DSP mode (FS-framed cycles, data changing on SCLK rising edges, FS reset of the 4-bit counter): FS must be tied high

extended sampling: CSTART rising starts a conversion (pins.convst), but the CSTART-only-while-CS-high condition, the 'toggle CS twice to leave extended mode' rule and the internal-reference-only restriction in modes 01-11 are not modeled

power-down: software power-down (8h) and PWDN pin; an active CS/FS/CSTART restores the device (modeled as a wakeup when the next command completes); autopower-down after each conversion and the 20 ms internal reference warm-up are not modeled; the first conversion after power up or power-down is invalid
EOC (CFR D2 = 1, mode 00): low from the end of sampling until the conversion completes; INT (D2 = 0, or any mode other than 00): falls when data are ready, cleared by the next CS fall

tOut: td(SCLK-DOV) is 0.5 SCLK + 19 ns after the SCLK rising edge (VCC 2.7 V, 25 pF), i.e. 19 ns after the falling edge; parts with date codes before 31xxxxx change SDO on the rising edge (p.34); no CS-high-to-Z time is given (tFloat 0)
SCLK cycle time 75 ns min at 2.7-3.6 V (50 ns at 4.5-5.5 V)
variants: TLV1504 (same datasheet): 4-channel version, separate device. 12-bit pin-compatible upgrades: TLV2544/TLV2548.
